premise: Night falls on the base and lasts two weeks; the floodlights come on, everyone works and sleeps and works and sleeps, and at last the Sun comes back over the ridge.
inspiration: Perrault's 'Sleeping Beauty' (the long sleep), turned: the whole base shares one very long night, and the waking is an ordinary, wonderful morning.
learning: A night on the Moon lasts about two weeks.

en-US.title: The Longest Night
en-US.text: [softly] On the Moon, the Sun takes its time. {canvas:nightfall 14s} When night falls, it stays: about two whole weeks of dark. {all:face surprised} Two weeks! {all:hop} So the base gets ready. {canvas:floodlights 20s} The floodlights come on, bright pools on the grey dust. {all:pulse} Everyone works a little. {all:face sleeping} Everyone sleeps a little. {all:face happy} Everyone wakes up, works a little more, has a snack, and sleeps again… [whispers] The stars stay out. The Earth glows blue over the ridge. {all:glow} The base hums quietly to itself, sleep after sleep after sleep. [pause] {all:face sleeping} And then, one morning — though it's hard to tell which — {canvas:daybreak 10s} a thin white line of sunlight creeps over the ridge. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} [excited] Morning! {all:sparkle} [happily] The longest night is over. Only two weeks till the next one.

es-ES.title: La noche más larga
es-ES.text: [softly] En la Luna, el Sol se toma su tiempo. {canvas:nightfall 14s} Cuando se hace de noche, se queda: unas dos semanas enteras de oscuridad. {all:face surprised} ¡Dos semanas! {all:hop} Así que la base se prepara. {canvas:floodlights 20s} Se encienden los focos, charcos de luz sobre el polvo gris. {all:pulse} Todos trabajan un poco. {all:face sleeping} Todos duermen un poco. {all:face happy} Todos se despiertan, trabajan otro poco, meriendan algo y vuelven a dormir… [whispers] Las estrellas siguen ahí. La Tierra brilla azul sobre la cordillera. {all:glow} La base zumba bajito, sueño tras sueño tras sueño. [pause] {all:face sleeping} Y entonces, una mañana —aunque cuesta saber cuál—, {canvas:daybreak 10s} una fina línea blanca de sol asoma por la cordillera. {all:face happy} {all:hop x2} [excited] ¡Buenos días! {all:sparkle} [happily] Se acabó la noche más larga. Solo faltan dos semanas para la siguiente.
